workstream: P5 / AC1018-AC1021 TABLE title/header/data row style and height overrides

authority.dwgDocument: Open Design Specification for .dwg files v5.4.1

fields.0x020000: title text-style hard pointer, DXF group 7
fields.0x040000: header text-style hard pointer, DXF group 7
fields.0x080000: data text-style hard pointer, DXF group 7

authority.dxfEvidence: The Autodesk TABLE group-code reference defines groups 7 and 140 at entity level with one entry per cell type. It separately defines group 141 as one physical row height per row.
authority.limitation: Autodesk does not state the order of repeated cell-type values. ODA gives title/header/data order for the DWG sequence; generated controls apply that order but do not establish physical DXF producer order or native precedence.

implementation.behavior: DRW_Table retains DXF group-7 row STYLE names separately from DWG hard-pointer handles, parses selected group-140 values into title/header/data row-height slots, and validates selected-field cardinality. The writer resolves hard pointers only through the emitted STYLE registry, requires exactly one source STYLE name, rejects missing/duplicate/wrong-type/ambiguous/un-emitted targets, and checks any retained name agrees with its source handle. Selected finite row heights, including zero, serialize as repeated group 140 values. Unselected orphan values and non-finite selected heights refuse output. The DWG retained override mask now includes all modeled bits through 0x400000; border masks remain subject to strict output refusal.
implementation.generatedControl: From-scratch TABLE tags cover all three title/header/data names and heights, selected zero height, mixed cell-level and entity-level overrides, parseback, and missing/excess selected group-7/group-140 values in ASCII and Binary DXF.
implementation.outputControl: ASCII/Binary adapter output checks exact group-code order/count/value, hard-pointer-to-emitted-STYLE resolution, fresh typed readback, duplicate STYLE-name and missing-handle atomic refusal, non-finite height refusal, destination preservation, and corrected same-writer retry.

limits: Generated codec mapping only; no physical DXF repeated-value order witness, producer breadth, native precedence, or rendering qualification.
Group 141 per-physical-row heights remain distinct from group 140 row-style heights.
TABLE border CMC, lineweight, and visibility overrides remain output-refused pending exact slot-to-DXF mapping.
No broader TABLE, whole-drawing, or product support claim is promoted.
next: Audit ODA's 18-slot border lineweight and visibility order against Autodesk groups 274-279 and 284-289. Map only if the six edge categories and repeated title/header/data ordering are exact; otherwise preserve fail-closed output.
